scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @party-games/shared build && pnpm --filter @party-games/game-core build && pnpm --filter @party-games/clocktower build && pnpm --filter @party-games/poker build && pnpm --filter @party-games/gomoku build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @party-games/server build && pnpm --filter @party-games/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @party-games/server dev" "pnpm --filter @party-games/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @party-games/game-core test && pnpm --filter @party-games/clocktower test && pnpm --filter @party-games/poker test && pnpm --filter @party-games/gomoku test && pnpm --filter @party-games/server test
